Gene-level comparison and boxplot visualization using limma

rna_boxplot.Rd

Performs differential expression analysis for a single gene using a linear model fitted with limma, optionally including batch effects. The function computes log2 fold-change (log2FC), 95% confidence interval, p-value, and Cohen's d, and generates a combined violin + boxplot visualization with individual sample points.

Gene identifiers can be provided as Ensembl (with or without version), ENTREZID, or gene symbol. Annotation is performed automatically using organism-specific org.*.eg.db databases.

Usage

rna_boxplot(
  project,
  gene,
  group_col = "Group",
  batch_col = NULL,
  style = c("boxplot", "violin"),
  colors = NULL,
  show_signif = TRUE,
  seed = NULL,
  save = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

project

rna_project object created by rna_project().

gene

Character. Single gene identifier (Ensembl ID, ENTREZID, or SYMBOL).

group_col

Character. metadata column defining experimental groups.

batch_col

Character. Optional metadata column defining batch effects to include in the design matrix.

style

Character. Whether use boxplot or violin for data visualization.

colors

Character. Optional box colors.

show_signif

Logical. Whether to display significance annotation (asterisks based on p-value) on the plot.

seed

Optional. Set a seed for reproducibility for point jitter.

save

Logical. Whether to store results in rna_project$analyses$boxplot.

verbose

Logical. Whether to print informative messages.

Value

Invisibly returns a list containing:

  • gene: Gene identifier used in the expression matrix.

  • gene_label: Gene symbol (if available).

  • contrast: Comparison vector (test, reference).

  • groups: Named list with test and reference.

  • statistics: List with:

    • logFC: log2 fold-change (test − reference)

    • CI_low, CI_high: 95% confidence interval

    • p_value: p-value from limma

    • cohen_d: Effect size

    • scale: Expression scale used

  • design: Model formula used

  • method: Statistical method ("limma")

This function is typically used after rna_normalize() and before downstream analyses such as rna_compare(), or clustering.

Details

The contrast is always defined as test − reference, which determines the sign of the log2 fold-change. However, for visualization purposes, groups are displayed in the order reference → test (left to right) to improve interpretability.

The plot combines:

  • Violin plot (distribution)

  • Boxplot (median and IQR)

  • Jittered points (individual samples)

  • Optional significance annotation

Results can be stored in the active rna_project for reproducibility.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Basic usage
rna_boxplot(project = my_project,
            gene = "TP53")


# Changing style
rna_boxplot(my_project,
            gene = "TP53",
            style = "violin")
} # }
